label: NECESSARY_14: validity over all small modal frames
definition: AllFrameKValidity phi quantifies every small world type W, every Frame W, every valuation and world, with Holds of the same Modal.Formula. There is no frame-law restriction. This is semantic K validity of this language, with no completeness or proof-system claim.
note: Analyst formulation, attribution deferred. Implication identity and axiom K are examples; axiom T is invalid on a no-edge Unit frame with a false atom. The Type universe restriction is explicit: this declaration is not an assertion about every language, logic, first-order structure or existence signature. Reuses Modal.Kripke Holds/Valid and NecessarySenseFork; no causal, temporal or essence interpretation is encoded. Distinct declarations give explicit meanings rather than opaque flags.
